caption: Tropea and Santa Maria dell'Isola, Tropea
composition: Cliff-top town and rock sanctuary · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is a stone belvedere at the lower left, its railing and planters framing the floodlit old town massed along the cliff top in the center, with the pale bulk of Santa Maria dell'Isola standing apart on its rock at the right. Strings of lamplight trace the path down the cliff face to the dark sea below, and the sky behind holds a band of pink dawn at 06:41. The town glows like a lantern against the deep blue water.
